items.definition:
a native or inhabitant of Hawaii
Many Hawaiians are proud of their culture.

a holiday taken by a newly married couple
They went to Paris for their honeymoon.

a precious stone, typically a diamond, emerald, ruby, or sapphire, used in jewelry
She wore a beautiful jewel around her neck.

the continuous line forming the boundary of a closed geometric figure
The police secured the perimeter of the building.

a person who plays the pipes, especially bagpipes
The piper played a traditional Scottish tune.

a person who preaches, especially a minister of religion
The preacher delivered a powerful sermon.

a person or thing that protects someone or something
He acted as a protector for his younger sister.

a cylinder on which film, wire, or thread is wound
He carefully wound the fishing line onto the reel.

a practice or trial performance of a play, concert, or other work
The band had one final rehearsal before the big concert.

the natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance
The train journey offered breathtaking scenery of mountains and lakes.

a basic or essential item of food, clothing, or other commodity
Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.

a person who believes in something
She is a strong believer in education.

a stimulant found in coffee and tea
I need some caffeine to wake up.

a person who lacks courage
He was called a coward for running away.

a slight hollow in a surface
There's a small dent in the car door.

a type of bird, often a symbol of peace
A white dove flew over the garden.

a thread or filament from which a vegetable tissue, mineral, or textile is formed
This cereal is high in dietary fibre.

a word or phrase preceded by a hash sign (#), used on social media to identify messages on a specific topic
Use the hashtag #ThrowbackThursday for old photos.

A student or trainee who works, sometimes without pay, in order to gain practical experience.
She worked as an intern at the law firm last summer.

A person or organization that lends money.
The bank is a major lender for small businesses.

A cloud of tiny water droplets in the air.
The morning mist made it hard to see the road.

A small burrowing mammal, or a small dark spot on the skin.
The gardener was annoyed by the molehills in his lawn.

A short undergarment worn by women and girls.
She bought a new panty and bra set.

an area of red spots on the skin
The baby developed a rash after eating strawberries.

the area along the side of a river
We enjoyed a picnic by the riverside.

a small drink
She took a small sip of her coffee.

a person who changes words from one language into another
She works as a translator for international conferences.

a private teacher
My math tutor helped me improve my grades.

a skin condition causing pimples
Many teenagers suffer from acne.

a place where beer is made
We visited a local brewery and tasted some craft beers.

overcrowding or blockage
There is heavy traffic congestion on the main road.

a ten-cent coin
Can I borrow a dime for the parking meter?

a difference of opinion
There was a strong disagreement about the best way forward.

a fast-running, long-eared mammal similar to a rabbit
The tortoise and the hare raced each other.

a person who is overly intellectual, obsessive, or socially awkward
He was a bit of a nerd in high school, always studying.

a red cosmetic for coloring the cheeks or lips
She applied a touch of rouge to her cheeks.

a currently circulating story or report of uncertain or doubtful truth
There's a rumour going around that they're getting married.

a strong push
He gave the door a hard shove.

a game similar to baseball but played with a larger, softer ball
They played a game of softball in the park.

A tall, woody grass.
Pandas love to eat bamboo.

An aromatic herb used in cooking.
Fresh basil adds a lot of flavor to pasta sauce.

A group of notes played together; a straight line segment whose endpoints both lie on the circle.
He played a beautiful chord on the guitar.

An unroofed area that is completely or mostly enclosed by the walls of a large building.
The old castle had a beautiful courtyard.

The style and arrangement of furnishings and other things in a room.
The restaurant had a very modern decor.

Slight pain or uneasiness.
He felt a slight discomfort in his knee.

A mythical creature, typically depicted as a small, mischievous, childlike figure with pointed ears.
The children believed in Santa's elves.

writings or drawings scribbled, scratched, or sprayed illicitly on a wall or other surface in a public place
The wall was covered in colorful graffiti.

a large marine crustacean with a cylindrical body, stalked eyes, and the first of its five pairs of limbs modified into large pincers
We ordered fresh lobster for dinner.

a network of paths and hedges designed as a puzzle through which one has to find a way
We got lost in the corn maze.

a place of entertainment open late at night
They went to a nightclub to dance.

the position in which someone holds their body
Good posture is important for back health.

the period before the start of a regular sports season
The team is training hard during the preseason.

a member of a powerful military caste in feudal Japan
The samurai were skilled warriors.

an unoccupied position or office or an empty room or space
There is a job vacancy in the marketing department.

forest, wooded area
We enjoyed a peaceful walk through the woodland.

end of a relationship
Their breakup was very difficult for both of them.

a type of dog
The bulldog has a very distinctive appearance.

a thick, solid piece
He cut a large chunk of bread.

a celestial body with a tail
Halley's Comet is visible from Earth every 75-76 years.

a separate section
The train has several compartments for passengers.

a person who takes part in a contest
Each contestant tried their best to win the prize.

a person who plays video games
My brother is a serious gamer.

a bar used for prying or lifting
Pull the lever to open the gate.

a game or mode allowing multiple players
We prefer games with a strong multiplayer component.
